trigger: Only if no candidate in the frozen four-arm factorial passes both +2-point SR and SPL gates; do not change that factorial.
mechanism: At each executed turn, leave-one-out terminal return among active group-four rollouts; standardize the active-peer contrasts to sample standard deviation one and assign the same contrast to each generated action token. Observation tokens have zero advantage.
excluded_feedback: No simulator geodesic or learned semantic process reward.
preflight: CPU synthetic checks, then a two-step real-environment smoke with full token and gradient audit before the 64-step run.
control: qwen3_exact_control_64step_seed11 from ActiveVLN_three_directions_20261002, re-evaluated on the same third screen
advance_gate: paired candidate minus control SR >= +2.0 and SPL >= +2.0 percentage points, exact 256 unique IDs, zero inference errors
scale_if_pass: matched three independent seeds, 512 train rows and 128 optimizer steps; do not claim unseen-scene gain from this development screen
limitations: Uses val-seen for development; the same scenes may have been used in earlier research. This implementation is a new update rule, not a post-hoc correction to the active run.
